Manufacturing Hiring
A Skills-First Approach to Manufacturing Recruitment
Facing a growing manufacturing skills gap, it is crucial that recruitment teams can quickly identify, engage, and convert the skilled talent they need to keep their companies competitive.
Manufacturing Recruitment Requires a New Approach
The skills needed to succeed in the fourth industrial revolution are in short supply. Focus on the skills that matter with SHL’s Manufacturing Hiring Solution.
Make Hiring Meaningful
Use job-relevant skills and fit assessments to capture candidates’ attention, and deliver value through personalized video feedback, whatever the hiring outcome.
Make Accurate Hiring Decisions
Did you know that

decisions
is one of the ten job-critical skills for your manufacturing workforce. Make sure you are focusing on the skills that matter with SHL’s dedicated Manufacturing Hiring Solution.
With accurate skills insights, you are able to confidently make offers before the competition and get ahead.
Expand Your Talent Pools
Avoid limiting your search to those with past manufacturing experience. By focusing on skills that SHL has determined critical in these roles, you can look at each candidate’s potential to upskill or reskill.
Evaluate Critical Manufacturing Skills
SHL’s Process Monitoring is an immersive game-based assessment that evaluates participants sustained attention, vigilance, and decision-making skills. Engage candidates with a realistic control panel to monitor and measure their ability to respond to instrument feedback within specified safe control limits. Use actionable insights to secure high-quality talent and boost their effectiveness on the job.
